scientific_integrity: An individual-idempotent census is acknowledged prior work. The new claim is pairwise compatibility and the all-size decorated-packing polynomial; computations verify a theoretically complete five-label reduction. Independent assessment was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed corank-two idempotent stratum of the Brauer monoid; no full-rank-spectrum or Brauer-algebra claim. Universal commutation reduction depends on exhaustive five-label certificate. Older 2006 thesis was not available in full text; literature priority is not externally certified.
title: Commuting-clique polynomial of the corank-two Brauer idempotents
